title: Rams acquiring Myles Garrett from Browns for Jared Verse in blockbuster trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams acquiring Myles Garrett from Browns for Jared Verse in blockbuster trade
sources.description: The Rams are acquiring Browns star Myles Garrett in a blockbuster trade, sending Jared Verse and a 2027 first-round pick to Cleveland in exchange for the star pass rusher.
